results.reason: Some connect() paths catch exceptions without guaranteed disconnect(), which can leak lock/socket resources.
results.minimal_fix_strategy: Wrap connect()+app_start/app_end sections in try/finally and always call disconnect() in finally when connection was established.

results.reason: UI-thread methods execute potentially long blocking device I/O (connect/app_start/app_end).
results.minimal_fix_strategy: Move startup/shutdown device operations to a worker thread and signal completion back to UI.

results.reason: STOP flag is checked only at loop boundary, so a stop request can race and still allow one new acquisition to start.
results.minimal_fix_strategy: Re-check stop immediately before acq_and_wait() (and after parameter updates) to prevent post-STOP starts.

results.reason: AcqStart is issued but no explicit AcqEnd is sent by the initiating component.
results.minimal_fix_strategy: Add explicit AcqEnd API and invoke it in the same control path that performs AcqStart.

results.reason: Exclusive file lock is acquired for each active device connection, preventing concurrent LIVE/measurement control among lock-respecting clients.
latest.json is overwritten directly without atomic write, so interruption during write can leave unreadable JSON.
results.minimal_fix_strategy: Write to temporary file and atomically replace latest.json; optionally keep last-known-good fallback.
